svg.title: Football connections, a daily quiz, and shared careers
svg.desc: Easy, Medium and Hard secure the daily streak, with an optional Impossible. Who played for both Inter and PSG? Ibrahimović and Thiago Motta both played for Inter, PSG and Barcelona during their careers.
